name: report

slots.says: what this is, in one sentence

slots.says: the metric the table ranks by

slots.name: verdict
slots.says: one bolded verdict line, after the evidence

finish_line.says: the headline result is a table
every Total row equals the sum of its column
a Sources section names where every number came from
limitations come before the sources, at the end
every number traces to its source of record, and monitored figures are not headline numbers
